Call when an agent needs whether a year is a leap year under the proleptic Gregorian rule. Not a holiday answer.
Call when an agent has an integer number of Unix seconds and needs the UTC date. POSIX time does not count leap seconds. Not a live clock.
Call when an agent has a 17-digit GSIN and needs the GS1 check digit. Not a shipment lookup.
Call when an agent has a GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 and needs the GS1 check digit. Not a product or a price.
Call when an agent has an ISNI and needs the ISO 7064 MOD 11-2 checksum. Does not identify a person or an organisation.
Call when an agent has an 18-digit SSCC and needs the GS1 check digit. Does not confirm the logistic unit.
Call when an agent has a 12-digit UPC-A and needs the GS1 check digit. Not a product or a price.
Call when an agent needs a BIP-173 Bech32 checksum check. Decoded payload is not returned. Not a balance.
Call when an agent has an Australian Business Number and needs the ABR modulus-89 checksum. Does not confirm the entity is registered.
Call when an agent needs the stored Super Bowl winner for the calendar year of the game. Unknown years return 404. Not a live score.
Call when an agent needs the host city of a held Winter Olympic Games. Unknown and cancelled years return 404. Not a live event.
Call when an agent needs the stored men's European Championship final for a tournament year. Unknown years return 404. Not a live score.
Call when an agent needs an RFC 4648 or Crockford base32 length check. Decoded bytes are not returned.
Call when an agent needs the IANA meaning of an HTTP status code. Unknown codes return 404. Not a live server status.
Call when an agent has a UUID and needs the RFC 9562 version and variant. Not a registry lookup.
Call when an agent needs Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence for two versions. Build metadata is ignored. Not a package registry.
Call when an agent has a file extension and needs the Apache mime.types media type. Unknown extensions return 404. Not a filename lookup and not a content sniff.
Call when an agent has an IMO ship identification number and needs the checksum. Does not confirm the ship or a name. UN/LOCODE is not stored.
Call when an agent has an ISO currency code and needs the CLDR English currency symbol. Unknown codes return 404. Not an exchange rate.
Call when an agent needs to know whether a postal code matches the stored format for a country. Not an address, a city, or a delivery check. Unknown countries return 404.
Call when an agent has an aircraft registration and needs the nationality prefix. Unknown prefixes return 404. Not a live register.
Call when an agent has an MMSI and needs the ITU maritime identification administration. Unknown identities return 404. Not a vessel lookup.
Call when an agent needs the molar mass of a simple formula from CIAAW abridged standard atomic weights. Elements with no standard weight return 404. Not a measured sample mass.
Call when an agent needs a standard Roman numeral or its integer value, from 1 to 3999. Nonstandard forms return 404.
Call when an agent has an SI prefix and needs its factor. Unknown prefixes return 404. Not a unit conversion.
Call when an agent has an element symbol and needs the IUPAC name and atomic number. Unknown symbols return 404. Not an isotope or a mass.
Call when an agent has a CAS Registry Number and needs the check digit. Does not confirm the substance.
Call when an agent has an aircraft nationality mark and needs the notified state. Unknown marks return 404. Not a live registration.
Call when an agent has a German VAT id and needs the checksum. Does not look up a registry or confirm the id is issued.
Call when an agent has an ISSN and needs the checksum result. Does not confirm the journal.
Call when an agent has an Incoterms 2020 code and needs who pays the main carriage. Does not draft a contract.
Call when an agent has an EVM chain id and needs the network name and native symbol. Not a gas price.
Call when an agent has an Ethereum address and needs the EIP-55 checksum form. Does not confirm the account or a balance.
Call when an agent has a 13-digit GLN and needs the GS1 check digit. Does not confirm a location or a company.
Call when an agent needs the day-of-year number for a calendar date.
Call when an agent has an ORCID and needs the ISO 7064 MOD 11-2 checksum. Does not confirm the researcher.
Call when an agent has a passport MRZ field or a TD3 line 2 and needs the ICAO 9303 check digit. Does not confirm the passport.
Call when an agent has an ISO 639-1 code and needs the English language name. Unknown codes return 404. Not a translation.
Call when an agent needs the listed capital of a country. Unknown or disagreed countries return 404. Not a live gazetteer.
Call when an agent has an ISO 3166-1 code and needs the English short name. Unknown codes return 404.
Call when an agent has an IATA airline code and needs the airline name. Unknown codes return 404. Not a live schedule.
Call when an agent has an IATA airport code and needs the city and country. Unknown codes return 404. Not a live schedule or a fare.
Call when an agent needs a date plus or minus a number of weekdays. Public holidays are not skipped.
Call when an agent needs the country-code top-level domain for a country.
Call when an agent needs the name of a country's men's top football division. Does not say which club is in it.
Call when an agent needs the host city of a past Summer Olympics. Historical only, not a live event.
Call when an agent needs the men's World Cup final result for a past year. Historical only, not a live score.
